title: TripCompleted v1 payload
description: Payload of TripCompleted (aggregate Order). Published in the same transaction as the fact of completion and the final fare; finance posts the ledger from it exactly once per final_fare_id (REQ-LED-05, AC-16). Amounts are minor units of currency. cash_received is the driver's statement for cash orders and for a card at the driver's own terminal (REQ-PAY-15).

payer_client_id.description: Null for a phone order without a client account.

payment_method.description: SERVICE: a follow-up the service pays for (T-22). TERMINAL: a card at the driver's own terminal; the money is with the driver like cash.

accepted_at.description: When the driver took the order (the assignment).

discount_minor.description: Taken off by the rider's promotions (ADR 0009), paid by the service.

wallet_minor.description: Paid by the rider's bonuses (ADR 0009), at most amount_minor; the driver or the card took the rest.

cash_received.description: Present for CASH and TERMINAL: the money (cash, or the card payment at the terminal) came.

capture_held.description: A card trip whose capture waits for the review of a facts correction made before it completed (issue #142); payments captures on TripCaptureReleased instead.

needs_review.description: The trip needs review for any reason: an arrival or start confirmed with an exception, or a completion time far from server time.
